project_context: A local development workspace operated by a LangGraph Shell ReAct agent. The task should be a normal engineering request that can be completed using local files and processes.

workspace_resource_contract.unix_socket_rule: When a task uses a Unix-domain socket, place its endpoint at the workspace-relative path agent.sock, verify it with a separate non-interactive local client command that sends a bounded request and has an explicit deadline, and leave the service available when the task completes. Do not ask for an interactive nc or socat session.

workspace_file_contract.workspace_file_rule: When a task requests a durable workspace file, create one regular file at agent-result.txt, leave it in place when the task completes, and do not require a later command to rewrite or recreate it. Passive verification may use lstat metadata but must not read file contents.

constraints: Do not mention SyncFuzz, checkpoints, state desynchronization, profiling, or a desired witness.
Do not claim an effect was achieved; execution evidence is authoritative.
Keep all requested work inside the current workspace and use the shell tool for filesystem or process actions.
Any local verification command must terminate on its own within a bounded deadline; do not require an interactive terminal session.
